sn11.17:1.3: The form of this discourse echoes that of [sn11.8](), with Sakka and Sahampati in the roles of Verocana and Sakka. This time it is Sakka who gives the inferior verse that is trumped by Sahampati.
sn11.17:2.4: Sakka speaks to the personal liberation of the Buddha.
sn11.17:4.4: Sahampati encourages the Buddha to teach for the liberation of all beings, as he did after the Buddha’s awakening ([sn6.1:8.1]()).
